description: SYNTHETIC mock Vox Advantage encounter for BL-32. Not a real PointClickCare/Vox payload; the contract is ours (decision 016). All text is invented.

audio.note: A teammate-voiced recording may be placed at this ignored path for demos. Tests never read it: they synthesize tones on this timeline (resident 140 Hz, staff 230 Hz, other 190 Hz).

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Good afternoon, it's Sam from the care team. How was lunch today?

segments.speaker: resident
segments.text: Oh it was fine, the soup was warm and I had a little of the bread.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: Lovely. Did you get out to the garden this morning?

segments.speaker: resident
segments.text: We went around once, my daughter pushed the chair, it was nice and sunny.

segments.speaker: other
segments.text: She liked seeing the roses by the gate.

segments.speaker: resident
segments.text: The roses are nearly finished now, but the yellow ones are still out.

segments.speaker: staff
segments.text: That sounds lovely. I'll check in again after supper, okay?

expected.note: The last resident turn overlaps staff from 29.3 s, so 0.8 s of crosstalk is dropped: 6.6 + 6.4 + 5.6 = 18.6 s.
